facts.en: Completed a diploma in International Trade Administration at Fictional Institute D067 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D067 完成国际贸易行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as an import purchasing assistant at Fictional Trading Office D067 from 2022-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2026-08 在虚构贸易办公室 D067 担任进口采购助理。

facts.en: Tracked supplier quotations and purchase-order acknowledgments for packaging accessories; buyers approved orders.
facts.zh: 跟踪包装配件供应商报价及采购订单确认；采购员批准订单。

facts.en: Recorded quoted currency, unit, validity date and freight basis in separate spreadsheet columns.
facts.zh: 在不同电子表格列中记录报价币种、单位、有效日期及运费基础。

facts.en: For a 2026-02 comparison exercise, recorded Supplier A at USD 12 per carton of 24 pieces and Supplier B at EUR 10 per carton of 20 pieces.
facts.zh: 在 2026-02 比较练习中，记录供应商 A 报价为每箱 24 件、每箱 12 美元，供应商 B 为每箱 20 件、每箱 10 欧元。

facts.en: Those quotes have different currencies and pack sizes; no approved exchange rate was supplied and no cross-currency cheapest-supplier conclusion was drawn.
facts.zh: 这些报价币种及包装数量不同；未提供获批汇率，也未得出跨币种最低价供应商结论。

facts.en: Flagged missing pack-size and currency fields rather than assuming a unit or converting prices independently.
facts.zh: 标出缺失包装数量及币种字段，而非自行假定单位或独立换算价格。

facts.en: With the purchasing officer, reviewed 52 quotations received during 2025-11.
facts.zh: 与采购专员合作，复查 2025-11 收到的 52 份报价。

facts.en: The team obtained missing unit descriptions for 9 of 11 incomplete quotes among the 52; 2 remained pending and were excluded from comparison.
facts.zh: 团队从 52 份中的 11 份不完整报价取得 9 份缺失单位描述；2 份仍待处理，未纳入比较。

facts.en: Followed up on agreed shipping dates and routed delivery-term questions to the buyer rather than providing customs advice.
facts.zh: 跟进商定发货日期，并将交货条款问题转交采购员，而非提供海关建议。

facts.en: Drafted a freight-comparison sheet in 2026-05; it remained unused because weight and surcharge definitions were incomplete.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草运费比较表；因重量及附加费定义不完整而未使用。

facts.en: Handled a peak of 28 open quotation requests in 2025-10; the 2026-08 active list contained 16.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 高峰期处理 28 个未完成询价请求；2026-08 活跃清单有 16 个。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Model Railway Club V067 from 2024-01 to 2024-06 on Saturdays while employed.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2024-06 任职期间，星期六在虚构模型铁路社团 V067 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the club, labeled storage boxes by model scale; no international purchasing was involved.
facts.zh: 为该社团按模型比例标记储物箱；不涉及国际采购。

facts.en: Enjoys making miniature paper buildings and keeps a personal materials notebook.
facts.zh: 喜爱制作微型纸建筑，并保留个人材料笔记。

facts.en: A draft summary converts all quoted amounts into dollars using an undated rate; the source and approval of that rate are unknown.
facts.zh: 一份摘要草稿使用未注明日期的汇率将全部报价换算为美元；该汇率来源及审批情况未知。

facts.en: No authority to approve exchange rates, hedge currency exposure, classify customs tariffs or sign supplier contracts is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录批准汇率、对冲货币敞口、分类海关税则或签署供应商合同的权限。

facts.en: Maintained original supplier files alongside the quote register so reviewers could check terms and units.
facts.zh: 在报价登记表旁保留原始供应商文件，使审核者能够检查条款及单位。
